sloka: गृहाण च वरं सौम्य यत्त्वमिच्छस्यरिन्दम ।स्वर्गभाङ्नहि शूद्रो ऽयं त्वत्कृते रघुनन्दन ।। ७.७६.८ ॥
transliteration: gṛhāṇa ca varaṁ saumya yattvamicchasyarindama ।svargabhāṅnahi śūdro 'yaṁ tvatkṛte raghunandana ।। 7.76.8 ॥

translations.english: "O gentle one, subduer of enemies, and delight of the Raghus, accept any boon you desire, for this Shudra will certainly not attain heaven because of your action."
